title: Extended-Stay Multiplier on RideLink Late-Settlement Credit
content:
For Non-Emergency Medical Transportation trips with a long stay away from home, the late-settlement credit rate on the trip's settlement is multiplied according to the length of the stay.

**Rule.** The late-settlement credit rate is scaled by the lodging nights recorded on the latest lodging and meals entry on the ledger when that entry carries the trip's trip date: at least the extended-stay nights of 14 scales it by the extended-stay multiplier of 2.0; at least the long-stay nights of 7 but fewer than 14 scales it by the long-stay multiplier of 1.5; fewer nights, or a latest lodging and meals entry for another trip date, or none, leaves it unscaled.

The trip's trip date is the trip date of the trip's mileage entry, the latest approved mileage entry on the member's reimbursement ledger; the lodging and meals entry looked at is the latest approved lodging and meals entry on the same ledger.

## Nights bands

| Latest lodging and meals entry | Lodging nights on it | Credit rate multiplied by |
|---|---|---|
| Carries the trip's trip date | 14 or more | 2.0 |
| Carries the trip's trip date | 7 to 13 | 1.5 |
| Carries the trip's trip date | 6 or fewer | Unscaled |
| Carries another trip date | Any | Unscaled |
| None on the ledger | — | Unscaled |

## Worked figures

*Hypothetical:* a 1 percent credit rate on a trip whose latest lodging and meals entry, dated to the trip, records 9 lodging nights becomes 1.5 percent; on approved amounts of 400.00 USD that is a credit of 6.00 USD. With 14 nights the rate becomes 2 percent, a credit of 8.00 USD.
